title: Annotif: A System for Annotating Mobile Notifications in User Studies
future_completion_boundary: The paper supports an ordered, source-located specification and normalized synthetic probes for the five server stages. It does not release a study-bound build, raw notification JSON, source data, server/browser code, or several decisive tie, hash, calendar, and privacy details; no exact study execution or numerical result reproduction is claimed.

scope_decision: retain candidate: the study itself collects and analyzes Android NotificationListener event-derived records, not merely a screenshot or aggregate counter

artifact_sweep.supplement: No separate supplement, raw schema, data dictionary, or supplementary URL is named in the 12-page paper; no supplement identity verified.
artifact_sweep.study_code: No Annotif Android/server/browser repository, commit, tag, APK, or released source JSON is named or bound to this study in the paper; searched exact title/authors/repository links without a verified study build.
artifact_sweep.linked_collector: Reference [43] is Notification Log, DOI 10.1145/3267305.3274118. The authors' public https://github.com/interactionlab/android-notification-log README lists Annotif as a project, but its present master HEAD 7077c6a7b111a5a27a460d2583a12b21fecacca9 is not evidence for the modified 2019 Annotif app/server/browser, a study commit, or literal study JSON keys. No release tags were returned by git ls-remote --tags on 2026-09-25.
artifact_sweep.raw_data: Neither notification-event rows nor participant annotations are supplied by the paper or verified attached artifact; only aggregate Table 1, Table 2, and figures are public.
artifact_sweep.bibliographic_neighbors: [29] My Phone and Me, [36] Dismissed!, [37] Large-scale Assessment, [43] Notification Log, and Android API [12] were checked as reference identities; their processing rules are not imported into this target's method. Remaining background references are not full-text checked in this isolated draft.

event_model.annotation_path_evidence: Only a new-notification event is explicitly followed through metadata extraction, encryption, local storage, server filters, and annotation; removed callback routing is not described.
event_model.raw_event_vs_presented_alert: The paper explicitly warns that app updates and group-summary behavior can cause multiple listener events per displayed notification; a callback is not an already-deduplicated visible alert.
input_fields_explicit: group summary distinction required by filter 4

indispensable_unavailable_facts: Exact deployed Android listener, server, and browser code/build versions and literal JSON schema are not released or study-bound in verified artifacts.
How removed callbacks are persisted, matched, or discarded is not reported; they must not be inferred to enter the five-stage annotation pipeline.
Notification identity, update/revocation key, group-summary flag extraction, and callbacks' occurrence/creation timestamp relation are unreported.
Age-window equality, current-time evaluation moment, calendar-day timezone/boundary, and equal-time cluster ordering are unreported.
SHA-256 input encoding/normalization, ordering meaning of first duplicate, and duplicate handling across day-clusters are not fully specified beyond the stated per-cluster rule.
AES-CBC parameters, PBKDF2 parameters, IV/salt handling, transport details, local/server database schemas, batch cadence and retries are unreported.
Name-matching regex, contact string normalization and privacy boundary, location provider/freshness, and exact annotation record linkage are unreported.
Exact emoji positions, WhatsApp tag field and matching semantics, normalized-rating transform, k-means initialization/seed, and statistical missingness rules are unreported.
No raw cohort rows, annotations, or study-specific code are available to test published counts and downstream results.

not_semantically_equivalent.reason: This class is a logged Android UsageStats event, not a posted/removed NotificationListener callback or a versioned notification JSON record.
It represents notification evidence related to user behavior, not five-stage filtering, persistent notification identity, privacy release, or participant annotation.
Those are Android UsageStats event codes 10/12 and cannot stand in for NotificationListener posted/removed callbacks, group keys, content hashes, or actual display.
App/device durations are not app/day notification annotation clusters or notification lifecycle states.
